name: Asahi Shuzo
about: Asahi Shuzo began brewing in 1830 in what is now Nagaoka, Niigata, under the shop name Kubotaya, and became a company in 1920. Its brewing follows the Koshiji tōji tradition.

In 1985 it released Kubota, created by its then president and plant manager as a light, dry sake at a time when demand in the region was falling. It also makes Asahiyama. In 2024 it completed the Koshiji Distillery.
